meta.title: 方圆脸出片秘诀！靠的是角度！
meta.title_en: Round Faces Photograph Well: It's All Angles

scenes.context: 方圆脸拍照没你想的那么难，一直需要找到好看的角度，今天毫无保留把技巧全告诉你。
sentences: Round faces aren't hard to photograph.
Find the right angle and win.
paraphrase: Round faces aren't hard to photograph.
Find the right angle and win.
scenes.speak: Round faces aren't hard to photograph. Find the right angle and win.

scenes.context: 用的就是16 Pro Max和自拍杆，可以伸展到1米7，按钮和蓝牙打开连接。
sentences: A selfie stick helps find angles.
paraphrase: A selfie stick helps find angles.
scenes.speak: A selfie stick helps find angles. Bluetooth pairs the remote shutter.

scenes.context: 后置脸这一块会显得极其宽大，换成前置脸就小了很多，所以出片秘诀是自拍。
sentences: The rear camera widens your face.
paraphrase: The rear camera widens your face.
scenes.speak: The rear camera widens your face. The front camera slims it.

scenes.context: 脸显平就拍三分之二侧脸，稍微侧一点点，这边留三分之一、那边留三分之二，脸一下子就有骨相显瘦了。
sentences: A flat face looks better at the 2/3 angle.
paraphrase: A flat face looks better at the 2/3 angle.
scenes.speak: A flat face looks better at the 2/3 angle. The profile instantly adds structure.

scenes.context: 不好看的这一边脸可以用发型进行一部分遮挡，让脸型线条流畅，脸型一下就变小。
sentences: Use hair to cover the other side.
paraphrase: Use hair to cover the other side.
scenes.speak: Use hair to cover the other side. Coverage smooths the face line.

scenes.context: 进阶玩法：镜头放低再把镜头抬起来，用舌头抵住上颚，双下巴就不容易露出来。
sentences: Lower the camera, then angle it up.
Press your tongue to the roof of the mouth.
paraphrase: Lower the camera, then angle it up.
用roof of the mouth换一种说法
Press your tongue to the roof of the mouth.
scenes.speak: Lower the camera, then angle it up. Press your tongue to the roof of the mouth.

scenes.context: 越不常规的视角往往让照片越来越特别，不要看镜头，把脸往上面看。
sentences: Look up instead of at the lens.
paraphrase: Look up instead of at the lens.
scenes.speak: Unusual views make photos special. Look up instead of at the lens.

scenes.context: 所有方圆脸拍照几乎都伴随身复合问题，拍照时不要把牙关咬紧，无论张嘴闭嘴牙齿都不可以咬紧。
scenes.speak: Don't clench your jaw. Relax the lower face.

practice: Round faces aren't hard to photograph.
The rear camera widens your face.
A flat face looks better at the 2/3 angle.
Press your tongue to the roof of the mouth.
